name: How should I prepare my home before a knockdown texture repair?
description: Move furniture and wall decor away from the work zone, verify that any underlying leaks are fully fixed, and track down your existing wall paint color and sheen

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before a knockdown texture repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a contractor arrives, clear personal belongings, wall hangings, and nearby furniture away from the work area. If the repair is on a ceiling, move rugs and center-room items or cover them completely. Locate any leftover wall paint or take note of the paint brand, color code, and sheen so matching the topcoat is straightforward. If the repair stems from a plumbing leak or roof issue, confirm the underlying moisture problem is completely resolved before scheduling texture work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Move furniture and wall decor away from the work zone, verify that any underlying leaks are fully fixed, and track down your existing wall paint color and sheen.
